user_problem: Institutional visitors cannot select collaboration procurement or editorial intent.
proposed_change: Add Partnership Procurement and Editorial inquiry types with clear routing consent text and a visible response standard.
dependency: Owner approval of recipient routing and service standard
acceptance_tests: Desktop mobile keyboard and no-JavaScript review; unknown query values ignored; all test messages delivered; privacy wording accurate.
risk: Misrouted or sensitive information; accidental implication that editorial interest affects acceptance.
stop_rule: Do not merge until routing endpoints are activated and two end-to-end test messages are received.

user_problem: Procurement and institutional reviewers lack one dated source of truth.
proposed_change: Create a capability/procurement page and versioned two-page PDF covering verified registrations services team evidence declarations and readiness boundaries.
dependency: Verified legal entity data registrations tax status bank/procurement readiness and approved CV facts
acceptance_tests: Every claim maps to evidence register; PDF date/version visible; download works; mobile/print review; no unsupported client or turnover claim.
risk: Publishing personal registration or banking data; overstating eligibility.
stop_rule: Stop if any required fact is unverified or unsuitable for public disclosure.

user_problem: Founder scholarship public resources pilots and organisational delivery can be misread as equivalent proof.
proposed_change: Add visible evidence taxonomy and label every proof item as Founder record Gurjas delivery Partner-confirmed Pilot or Public resource.
dependency: Owner review of all current proof records
acceptance_tests: Every public proof item has one class; organisational outcomes require permission records; quality check blocks unlabeled additions.
risk: Downgrading clarity through excessive labels or accidentally converting personal evidence into enterprise evidence.
stop_rule: Do not publish a GURJAS_DELIVERY label without a contract/completion record and permission decision.

user_problem: South Asia appears as an ambition rather than a bounded offer.
proposed_change: Publish the approved 90-day pilot with roles outputs exclusions application path and a prominent non-affiliation statement.
dependency: Owner-approved pilot scope plus at least one credible external expression of interest or decision to recruit publicly
acceptance_tests: No association logos; no partner names without permission; structured FAQ; desktop/mobile/accessibility review; inquiry event tested.
risk: A proposal may be mistaken for an official AMDISA SAU SAEIC or SAARC programme.
stop_rule: Do not create the public route until the exact non-affiliation wording and recruitment method are approved.

user_problem: Growth actions are not measurable by qualified intent.
proposed_change: Validate first-party events for partnership requests capability downloads diagnostics procurement queries brief subscriptions and editorial interest.
dependency: Corresponding user journeys exist and consent behaviour is approved
acceptance_tests: Event dictionary committed; no personal form data in analytics; consent respected; browser tests show exactly one event per action.
risk: Collecting personal data or double-counting events.
stop_rule: Do not enable an event that includes free-text form content email phone or document names.

user_problem: The mobile homepage remains long and disperses evidence across too many sections.
proposed_change: After W-001 to W-005 ship use measured journeys to shorten the homepage and route proof tools and methods into focused hubs.
dependency: At least 30 days of privacy-respecting event and scroll evidence
acceptance_tests: No loss of priority content or search routes; visual review at all breakpoints; baseline conversion paths preserved or improved.
stop_rule: Do not start before the measurement period and higher-priority institutional infrastructure are complete.
